svg.data-what: how DNA is packed, from the double helix to the condensed chromosome

g.data-what: the DNA double helix: two sugar-phosphate backbones and the base pairs between them
nucleosomes: DNA wound almost twice around a core of eight histone proteins, like beads on a string
the chromatin fibre: nucleosomes packed together into a thicker fibre

path.data-what: the protein scaffold the loops are anchored to

g.data-what: looped domains: the fibre folded into loops held at their base
a condensed chromosome as it looks during division
the two sister chromatids: identical copies of one DNA molecule, made before division

ellipse.data-what: the centromere, where the sister chromatids are held together

g.data-what: telomeres: repeated sequences capping the ends of each chromosome
